title: Mall World with my older bro
content: Might've been the only dream I had last night, at least the only one I remember. I was entering at a Target. Apparently, I was with my older brother. It appeared he was becoming a father, and I came along with him while he was getting things for the coming kid. I remember some infants' onesies (or costumes, even), and one looked like King from The Owl House. Only had as much cash as I have IRL, so didn't buy stuff, just kept up with my bro and the cart. Eventually he went off getting stuff in another aisle, and I didn't seem to be able to keep up and found myself lost elsewhere in the mall. Then it got creepy. There were old, dark halls in the place, and I found myself wondering about aimlessly, without direction between dim-lit indistinguishable outlets, until I ended up going into a dark one with black silk curtains over the windows and the entrance. Once in, I found myself in what looked like a blackened church, far vaster in size inside than what I saw outside. The only walkways were on the inward left and right sides, both with curtains drawn over, looking to converge into one another when looking behind. I hesitated to enter, and when I was back in the main area, it appeared there was now a priestess there. She said I was dead and was there to take me away. I was unsure of anything about the meaning of all of it, but I was brought out by her. My body felt to have lost all feeling, but my means of communication and vision remained, but in a capacity in which I could no longer blink. We spoke on our way out in a vehicle. It appeared we were in Lexington. I asked if I was going home, back at my home address, which we were. It was odd how even in death, we still spoke and saw one-another, just before reaching my final destination. The dream faded away as I lay there looking into the dark, bleak night sky, wondering if this really was the end of it all, or only of a place in some facet of existence. and that was when I woke, feeling gradually coming back into my then-numb limbs. &#x200B; &#x200B; And so that was the end of it. I'd love some observation from folks here. Not the all too sane, logical, and frankly boring psychological ones, but the more nebulous, creative, and spiritual perspectives. I for one hold the theory this was the prequel to my unwritten resurrection dream from earlier this year, the one where I woke up to find people attending my funeral.
